description: Tracks the content hash of each bootstrap seed record (metadata.bootstrap=true in seeds/database/*.json) as last applied by SeedLoaderAction. Lets the seed loader tell 'the seed file changed since we last applied it' (reconcile) apart from 'an operator changed the live row through a real write path since then' (leave alone) — see seed_loader_action.cpp. System-managed — never reachable through the generic entity API.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the seed record's canonical JSON as last applied
